title: Milestone 2026.04.56 Operational Retrospective — Full Analysis (Augmented)
augmentation_note: Conductor-generated Exp 739 artifact (schema carnot.retro.v1) reports cycle-only wall time (143 min, 11 experiments). This file is the authoritative full-milestone retro, augmented with actual timing data: 3744 min, 587 experiments. Pattern identical to .52/.55 gaps. Conductor cycle data preserved via improvement_actions_for_57 from the original artifact.
conductor_vs_actual_gap_explanation: Conductor cycle covered only 11 targeted experiments (Tier 2.1 deploy + FR-11 relay + PSV recovery + privacy filter). Full milestone included 587 cumulative experiments from all queue sources. The 264-min legacy re-execution overhead (Exps 425, 410, 383, 380-382) is the dominant recoverable component of this gap. The manifest fix patch (results/manifest_fix_patch.txt, written in Exp 731) was labeled a MANDATORY human action item in the .56 conductor retro but was NOT applied before milestone execution — evidenced by the identical slowest-5 composition in .56 vs .55.

slowest_experiments.title: Conductor timeout watchdog — RETRO-003 (17+ milestone carry)
slowest_experiments.root_cause: TWENTIETH consecutive milestone in the slowest-5 (.37 through .56). The .54 preflight v6 (Exp 703) and .55 preflight v7 (Exp 716) both confirmed retirement. Exp 731 (.56 preflight v8) cleared the zombie GPU process and wrote the manifest fix patch but did NOT retire Exp 425 from execution. Result: identical re-execution for a twentieth time. Cumulative Exp 425 overhead since .37: approximately 1,520 minutes (25.3 hours) of closed-experiment compute. This is now the single longest recurring bottleneck in any recorded research system in this project's history.

slowest_experiments.title: Live precision pipeline — 200 GSM8K, 5 variants, 2 models
slowest_experiments.root_cause: SEVENTEENTH consecutive milestone (.40 through .56). CONFIRMED RETIRED in .54 and .55. Re-execution continues to confirm that the exclusion manifest, while written, is not checked at conductor dequeue time. 1,000 sequential inference calls with no BatchedInferenceRunner applied — seventeenth consecutive milestone with this optimization available and unused. Cumulative avoidable overhead: approximately 908 min (15.1 hours).

slowest_experiments.title: Combined EORM + JEPA retrain on live pairs from Exps
slowest_experiments.root_cause: ELEVENTH consecutive appearance (.46 through .56). Sequential GPU 0 training with GPU 1 idle. DualGPU ThreadPoolExecutor fix validated in Exp 685 (.52 cycle, 2.0175x speedup) has been available for FOUR milestones without application. Cumulative foregone parallel savings: approximately 372 min (6.2 hours of parallel compute available but unused).

slowest_experiments.experiment_label: Checkpoint: Exp 380-382 live GPU benchmarks — partial
slowest_experiments.root_cause: EIGHTH consecutive appearance. Three formal retirement confirmations (preflight v5, v6, v7) with zero execution effect. This entry has now exceeded the Exp 308/309 precedent (12 milestones before exit) by one-third of its trajectory. At the current rate, it will surpass the 308/309 record in 4 more milestones without manifest code enforcement.

slowest_experiments.title: Live 100q Precision v8 — RETRO-033 eighth attempt, RETRO-033 closure attempt
slowest_experiments.root_cause: THIRD consecutive appearance. Per governance protocol, THREE consecutive slowest-5 appearances with no optimization applied triggers MANDATORY RETIREMENT. RETRO-033 was resolved in Exp 720 (.55 cycle, signed_improvement_200q=0.00510). Exp 527's experiment class has no remaining research mandate. BatchedInferenceRunner was never applied across three appearances. Add to exclusion manifest IMMEDIATELY and confirm retirement in .57 Phase 0 preflight.

slowest5_composition_change.note: COMPOSITION IDENTICAL TO .55 AND .54. This is the second consecutive milestone with no composition change after the .54 governance intervention confirmed all four legacy experiments retired. The manifest fix patch (results/manifest_fix_patch.txt) was written in Exp 731 and flagged as a blocker in the .56 conductor retro, but was not applied before execution. Identical slowest-5 durations (76/64/62/62/52) between .55 and .56 suggest zero structural change in the legacy experiment queue.

bottlenecks_identified: CRITICAL: MANIFEST FIX PATCH WRITTEN BUT STILL NOT APPLIED. results/manifest_fix_patch.txt was written in Exp 731 (.56 preflight v8). The .56 conductor retro (Exp 739, schema carnot.retro.v1) explicitly labeled this 'blocker: true, action_type: human_action_required'. Yet Exps 425, 410, 383, 380-382 re-executed in .56 with identical durations to .55. The manifest patch must be applied to scripts/research_conductor.py at the experiment DISPATCH SITE before any .57 dequeue. This is not a text recommendation — it is a binary gate: if the patch is not applied, .57 will waste another 264 min on zero-value legacy experiments. This is the THIRD consecutive cycle with this exact failure.

LEGACY RE-EXECUTION: 264 MINUTES WASTED ON CONFIRMED-RETIRED EXPERIMENTS. Combined duration of the four legacy experiments (76+64+62+62=264 min) consumed in .56 despite three formal retirement confirmations (preflight v5, v6, v7) and one manifest patch write (Exp 731). These 264 min represent a 7.0% wall-time tax on every milestone until the manifest code is fixed. At the observed deceleration rate (-52 min/milestone), fixing the manifest alone would deliver more improvement than five consecutive organic milestones.

SLOWEST-5 COMPOSITION UNCHANGED FOR SECOND CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE POST-RETIREMENT. The .54 governance intervention retired all legacy experiments and projected 322 min/milestone savings. Actual savings recovered in .55 and .56 combined: 0 min. The governance text works; the execution pathway does not. No further retro text will close this gap — only a code change at the conductor dispatch site.

EXP 527 THIRD CONSECUTIVE APPEARANCE — MANDATORY RETIREMENT TRIGGERED. Per established governance (Exp 308/309 precedent, documented in retros .49-.52): third consecutive slowest-5 appearance without optimization mandates retirement. RETRO-033 is closed (Exp 720). Exp 527 class has no remaining research mandate. Must be in the exclusion manifest before .57 Phase 0.

SEQUENTIAL GPU TRAINING PATTERN PERSISTS — ELEVENTH MILESTONE. Exp 383 ran sequentially on GPU 0 for the eleventh consecutive milestone. DualGPU fix (Exp 685, 2.0175x speedup) has been available since .52. GPU 1 was confirmed IDLE throughout .56 (temperature 42C, 0% util, 5MB VRAM at close — 5C cooler than GPU 0). The hardware is available; the parallelization is not applied.

PRE-FLIGHT TEST SUITE OVERHEAD — SIXTEENTH CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE UNRESOLVED. At 587 experiments, unconditional suite consumes approximately 587 min (15.7% of milestone wall time). Preflight v7/v8 incremental selection saves this for the conductor cycle only. Legacy queue experiments invoke pytest unconditionally. Until manifest enforcement retires legacy experiments, each new experiment added to the queue grows the unconditional test load by ~1 min/milestone.

PER-EXPERIMENT AVERAGE IMPROVED TO 6.0 MIN (PROJECT BEST). This is a genuine throughput improvement from .55's 6.58 min/exp despite +10 more experiments. The conductor cycle's gated experiments (Exps 721, 723 blocked, Exp 719 gated) reduced wasted compute. This is the one structural improvement confirmed in .56: gate discipline is working within the managed cycle.

CONDUCTOR-VS-ACTUAL WALL TIME GAP STRUCTURAL: 3601 MINUTES. The conductor cycle managed 11 experiments (143 min). Full milestone: 587 experiments (3744 min). This gap will exist as long as legacy experiments from unguarded queue sources run outside the conductor's managed cycle. Manifest enforcement (Priority 0) is the only fix; the gap is not a conductor reporting problem but a queue discipline problem.

GPU CLOSE: CLEAN — ZOMBIE FROM .55 CONFIRMED KILLED. Both GPUs at 5MB VRAM / 0% util / 47C (GPU 0) and 42C (GPU 1). The 5C thermal differential (GPU 0 warmer) is consistent with GPU 0 doing modest work during the cycle while GPU 1 remained idle. The .55 zombie (PID 368449, 24082MB GPU 1 VRAM) was killed per .56 preflight mandate. Clean-close streak RESET: .56 is the first clean close since .54 (streak = 1, prior streak = 14 before .55 break). This is a win that must be protected in .57.

PSV ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED AND RECOVERY CONFIRMED — NO LONGER A BOTTLENECK. Per Exp 736 (constraint specialization root cause) and Exp 737 (domain-diverse recovery confirmed), PSV is recovering. Not a .57 bottleneck assuming domain-diverse training continues. Monitor slopes only.

PRIVACY FILTER EXPS 729+730 BLOCKED FOR SECOND CONSECUTIVE CYCLE. Upstream dependency unresolved. If dependency cannot be identified and resolved in .57 planning, retire both experiments and redesign privacy filter v1 without the dependency. Two consecutive blocked cycles meets the retirement-review threshold.
improvements_suggested: PRIORITY 0 — APPLY MANIFEST FIX PATCH BEFORE ANY .57 DEQUEUE (HUMAN ACTION, MANDATORY GATE). Apply results/manifest_fix_patch.txt to scripts/research_conductor.py NOW, before reading the .57 roadmap. Verify by searching conductor-log.md for 'manifest_excluded' entries before the first .57 experiment dispatch. If no 'manifest_excluded' entries appear, the patch was not applied correctly. Do not begin .57 until this is confirmed. Estimated wall-time recovery: 264 min/milestone (7.0% of .56 total). This single action recovers more time than five consecutive organic improvements at the current deceleration rate.

PRIORITY 1 — RETIRE EXP 527 CLASS TO EXCLUSION MANIFEST. RETRO-033 closed (Exp 720, signed_improvement_200q=0.00510). Third consecutive slowest-5 appearance triggers mandatory retirement per governance. Add 'Exp 527: live 100q precision inference' to the exclusion manifest as part of the manifest patch application in Priority 0. Estimated recovery: 52 min/milestone (1.4%).

PRIORITY 2 — APPLY DUALGPU PARALLELIZATION TO EXP 383 CLASS. DualGPU fix (Exp 685, 2.0175x speedup validated in .52) has been available for FOUR milestones. Apply ThreadPoolExecutor parallel EORM+JEPA retrain (EORM on cuda:0, JEPA on cuda:1) to all joint retrain experiments. GPU 1 is confirmed idle throughout milestones. Estimated recovery: ~27 min/milestone (0.7%).

PRIORITY 3 — APPLY BATCHEDINFERENCERUNNER TO ALL LEGACY INFERENCE EXPERIMENTS. Exp 410 (1,000 sequential calls) would reduce from 64 min to approximately 32 min with BatchedInferenceRunner(batch_size=8). This is the seventeenth consecutive milestone this recommendation appears without implementation. If manifest enforcement (Priority 0) successfully excludes Exp 410, this becomes moot; if Exp 410 must run for any reason, apply the batching immediately.

PRIORITY 4 — CONFIRM RETRO-033 CLOSURE WITH SECOND 200Q TRIAL. Exp 720 signed_improvement=0.00510 (0.51%) is within typical statistical noise for 200 questions. Run one confirmation 200q trial in .57 with a different random seed. If positive: RETRO-033 definitively closed, Exp 527 class permanently retired. If negative: re-open RETRO-033 and investigate whether .55 Exp 720 was a statistical fluke.

PRIORITY 5 — RESOLVE PRIVACY FILTER UPSTREAM DEPENDENCY OR RETIRE EXPS 729+730. Second consecutive blocked cycle. Identify the upstream dependency blocking Exps 729+730. If resolvable in .57 planning, resolve it. If not, retire both experiments and redesign privacy filter v1 to remove the dependency. Two blocked cycles meets the governance retirement-review threshold.

PRIORITY 6 — ENCODE RETIREMENT THRESHOLD IN CONDUCTOR PLANNING CODE. Retro text has a 0% implementation rate for governance rules (proven across 12 milestones for Exp 425, 6 milestones for Exp 383). Encode the rule in scripts/research_conductor.py: 'if experiment.id in slowest5 for 3+ consecutive milestones, generate a retirement_review task as Experiment 0 in next roadmap.' This converts an 18-milestone governance failure into a 3-milestone maximum. The rule must be in code, not in this JSON.

PRIORITY 7 — FORMALLY CLOSE FR-11 RETRO. Per .56 conductor retro: Exp 734 (fr11_relay_operational=true) and Exp 738 (fr11_tier2_relay_functional=true) both confirmed. Update _bmad/traceability.md and openspec/capabilities/*/spec.md to mark FR-11 as OPERATIONAL. Eligible for formal closure in .57.

PRIORITY 8 — MAINTAIN GPU CLOSE DISCIPLINE. .56 achieved the first clean close since .55 (both GPUs at 5MB/0%/47C/42C). Add explicit GPU health assertion to .57 Phase 0 preflight: assert vram_mb < 100 and util_pct == 0 for both GPUs before dispatching experiment N+1. If any experiment leaves GPU state dirty, kill the holding process immediately rather than carrying it to the next milestone.

PRIORITY 9 — STRUCTURED TIMING LOG AT CONDUCTOR DEQUEUE SITE. The conductor-vs-actual gap (3601 min in .56) will exist until legacy experiments are excluded. Add a structured per-experiment timing JSON entry at the conductor's actual dispatch site to enable automated full-milestone retro construction. This is a code change in scripts/research_conductor.py (pending manifest patch application from Priority 0).
